notes.notes:

[h1]Happy Thanksgiving from everyone at Rice Cooker Republic!!![/h1]

The Holiday Season is closing in and with it, its celebration of Thanksgiving!

We all know what that means : Black Friday is just round the corner with its lot of great deals. It's a tough crowd to compete with for sure but we wouldn't have shied away from offering you [b]an opportunity to get your hands on Bokida with a sweet -75% discount![/b]

Wishing you a happy and relaxing time, with family, with friends, or simply taking the time to enjoy your own company and rest with hot cup of your favourite beverage ;-)

notes.title: Summer is upon us :-)
notes.notes:
Hi,

Today is the first day of summer in our northern hemisphere, and with the season's passing comes the time of warmer days and cheaper games!

This is the perfect time to enjoy Bokida, [b] 70% off during the summer sale [/b] so that you can join in the seasons' passing fun.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28590289/0267ad9e916b0919a71cd4213dd96fb7aa75101a.jpg[/img]

To a beautiful summer, with its hefty lot of wondeful play sessions!

notes.title: Celebrating the Lunar New Year !
notes.notes:
[b]Happy Lunar New Year to everyone![/b] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28590289/1f8c3813b4847898d97c25e8074a91ff214be9f1.jpg[/img]

To celebrate this event, the game [b]will be on sale (60% off) until Feb 19th[/b]  so that the dance of Bokida's planets may accompany the cycle of our own earthly Moon. And right after Valentine's Day, what better way to follow suit than with a love story of planetary proportions?

This is the ideal occasion to give the gift of eerie exploration and soothing playfulness to your friends & family members, or to indulge someone who's had Bokida in her or his wishlist for some time ;-)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28590289/7bda47e05ee544003af93a39c9a09d153a846442.jpg[/img]

[b]Best wishes and a happy Lunar New Year from everyone on the team @ Rice Cooker Republic![/b]

notes.title: Bokida update : the game is now playable in Chinese!
notes.notes:
Today we are adding a new flag to our collection: we're celebrating the addition of Chinese as a supported playable language in Bokida!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28590289/e7f1bd71eec740f723cea2b87435abeb435653e4.jpg[/img]

The new language option will go live later today...
The celebration will be accompanied by a week long sale, starting at 10:00 am PST, to mark this joyous development :-)

We have other content updates planned in the future and we'll be happy to tell you more about that at a later date, stay tuned!

notes.title: New content is coming to Bokida
notes.notes:
Completionists and other explorers have reasons to rejoice: we're introducing new content to the game and adding a way to track the location of all of the echoes. Gathering them all will now grant you a special reward...


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28590289/3383ecfcf9cb3e93090805f773630e479c4fe2df.jpg[/img]
 
[h1] Finding all the echoes [/h1] 
One of the temples in the world of Bokida now houses a map that will show Messengers out there where to find all of the echoes of the Dark planet.

This miniature version of the game's environment bears markers that identify the locations of the echoes you might have missed.

 [h1] Complete attunement [/h1] 
Now that the echoes are easier to find, it is also easier to open the gateways that require echoes to be unlocked. 

If you venture through those passages, exploring what lies beyond can lead you to a new, unsuspected place that will react to completely attuned Messengers...

notes.title: Release Day and First Reviews
notes.notes:
Yesterday, [b]Bokida - Heartfelt Reunion[/b] released into the world and we're happy to see the game finally find its way into the hands of players around the world.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28590289/78c658a875ec03b37d7dd2f2ad9632e1101c78e9.jpg[/img]

This also means that the first reviews are coming in, both on Steam and in the press, with notably a nice piece by Rock, Paper, Shotgun who granted Bokida its seal of approval!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28590289/a734db80e9ba339bff872b3abf910ea5072f7af7.jpg[/img]

You can check it out on the RPS website here:
https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2017/05/17/bokida-heartfeld-reunion-review/

We're also working on fixes and improvements that we will detail in an upcoming patch note.

Cheers,
The team @ Rice Cooker Republic
